policy: Every known release failure requires a permanent automated blocker before the next candidate tag.

incidents.rootCause: Legacy and normalized payment fields were both accepted, leaving inactive partial configuration ambiguous.
OCI index, platform manifest, Docker image ID and release digest were previously compared inconsistently.
Deployable changes were stacked on non-main PR bases and could be omitted from the final release line.
incidents.automaticBlocker: tag commit must be reachable from origin/main

incidents.rootCause: GitHub diagnostic artifact quota failures were mixed with test and formal evidence status.
incidents.automaticBlocker: diagnostic artifacts are non-blocking; formal OSS evidence remains blocking

incidents.rootCause: Root health checks did not prove guest table QR, reservation and staff routes worked.
DNS, TLS and callback host failures were first detected after deployment.
Database work could begin before the exact runtime configuration and migration lineage were validated.
A failure after traffic switching required reliable restoration of an already loaded previous image.
incidents.automaticBlocker: automatic rollback plus previous public identity verification
